fixture_notes.invalid_response_actions: Wrong player and stale decision id for every decision surface, plus malformed response kind, cancellation, mode bounds, missing/illegal/duplicate/extra target groups. Full encoded state, pending decision and continuation frames must remain unchanged; empty rejected events; then valid answer matches untouched state resumption.
fixture_notes.serialized: Invalid-response controls round-trip paused states. Recipient controls round-trip preinstruction states and token-only paused states.
fixture_notes.rhythm_fixture: Accurate named printed-card fixture includes both printed statics using existing SDK. No registered RhythmOfTheWild definition exists. Tests qualify its riot recipient restriction only, not countering behavior or full-card admission.
fixture_notes.opposite_token_grant: Synthetic IsToken grant is explicitly complementary to the printed IsNontoken restriction.
fixture_notes.fixture_entropy: Fixed literal fixture seeds; no official Phase 2 or Precision seeds generated or consumed.

production_review.confirmed_draft_defect: PendingTokenEntries.begin hypothetical subject lacked TokenComponent; IsToken and IsNontoken predicates thus reverse applicability for token recipients. Root owns production repair.
production_review.object_reference_gap: Three new answer types missing ObjectReferencePropagation objectReferences/withObjectReferences mapping. Current fixed token instructions create no permitted old-to-new object move and inherited Composite threads prior moves; no demonstrated fixed48 causal failure. Add parity routes for continuation integration.
inherited_unqualified_gaps: Source copy LKI and stale battlefield visit identity
Saga initial lore placement bypasses general counter modifiers
Intrinsic planeswalker/Battle entry counters can consult evolving coentrant state
Other token producers and paused ForEach batches

player_flow_static_trace.engine: PendingEntryContinuationResumer routes all three new answer types; Serialization registers them. Answers reuse existing ChooseColorDecision, ChooseOptionDecision, and ChooseTargetsDecision contracts.
player_flow_static_trace.server: PendingDecisionRouting.withClientRoutingId covers all three existing decision contracts. No new externally serialized decision shape.
player_flow_static_trace.frontend: DecisionUI routes color to ChooseColorDecisionUI, modes to ChooseOptionDecisionUI, single player-only target requirements to PlayerTargetingUI, and all other Aura/defender selections through ChooseTargetsUI/chooseTargetsWalk. Each indexed slot is collected before one response is submitted.
player_flow_static_trace.qualification_limit: Read-only source tracing only. No live client interaction, visual behavior, reconnect, masking, or network replay proof; those remain required for full player-facing admission.

primary_sources.claim: Rhythm grants riot only to nontoken creatures controlled by its controller. Riot is a replacement decision without a response window; multiple instances work separately.
primary_sources.line_anchor: Rhythm of the Wild; General Notes Gruul Keyword Ability Riot
primary_sources.rules_note: 2019 historical rules numbers are not used as current numbering.

primary_sources.claim: Current examined CR effective September 25, 2026: 303.4f-g,603.6a,614.12/12a/12b/13a,702.136a-b support Aura entry choice/no legal host, simultaneous entry observations, as-entry replacement planning, and riot instances.
Spider-Punk printed and granted riot clarifications; no response window, cannot receive counter implies haste, indefinite haste.
Stormsplitter copies current copiable values if still present or last battlefield copiable values if source leaves.
